title: ProcessGit Release Manifest
description: Machine-readable description of a single ProcessGit release. Attached as `release.json` to every GitHub Release. Consumed by `processgit update check`, the updater sidecar, and any third-party tooling that wants to discover what a release contains.

schema_version.description: Schema version for this manifest format. Incremented on breaking changes.

tag.description: Git tag for this release (with the leading `v`).

released_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the release was published.

prerelease.description: True if this is a pre-release (any tag containing `-`).

min_upgrade_from.description: Minimum source version that supports a direct upgrade to this release. `null` means any prior version is supported. If a target deployment's current version is older than this, it must do a stepwise upgrade through an intermediate release.

image.description: Container image published with this release.

repository.description: Image repository path within the registry.

digest.description: Multi-arch index digest in `sha256:...` form. This is the canonical identifier — pinning to the digest is reproducible across registry mirrors.

platforms.description: OCI platforms included in the multi-arch index.

additional_tags.description: Other tags that point at the same digest (e.g. `0.1`, `0`, `latest`). Informational only — never depend on these for verification.

binaries.description: Standalone binaries published with this release (in addition to the container image). Empty array if no binaries are shipped for this release.

variant.description: Optional build-variant marker (e.g. `gogit` for the pure-Go git build).

source.description: Source code archive for this release.

signing.description: How artifacts in this release are signed. Consumers use these fields to construct verification commands.

issuer.description: OIDC issuer used by the signing system.

identity_regex.description: Regex (PCRE-ish, as accepted by `cosign verify --certificate-identity-regexp`) matching the OIDC identity that signed the artifacts.

rekor_log_index.description: Sigstore Rekor transparency log index for the image signature. Optional; can be discovered by `cosign verify`.

release_notes_url.description: URL to the GitHub Release page for this version.

release_notes_markdown.description: Inline Markdown release notes. Optional — when present, lets updaters surface the changelog without an extra fetch.

migration.description: Database / state migration metadata for this release.

required.description: True if a migration must be run as part of the upgrade.

command.description: Command to run inside the image to perform the migration. Omitted for releases that don't need one.

estimated_downtime_seconds.description: Operator hint for how long the app may be unavailable during the migration.

breaking_changes.description: Human-readable list of breaking changes operators need to be aware of before upgrading.

deprecations.description: Human-readable list of newly-deprecated features that will be removed in a future release.

build.description: Build provenance metadata. Useful for debugging and verification.

commit.description: Git commit SHA the release was built from.

workflow_run_url.description: URL to the GitHub Actions run that produced this release.
